IDENT.title: A product-driven system approach to generate fast solutions to the job shop scheduling problem.

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Intelligent product adopted from Wong et al. (2014): representation of an order or physical product linked to information and rules governing its manufacture; agents as autonomous decision-making entities.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: The intelligent product is the representation of an order or physical product linked to the information and the rules that govern its manufacture, storage, or transport

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: allowing it to influence operations (Wong et al., 2014)

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: This article proposed a model of artificial intelligence with agents representing intelligent products

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: This approach has two types of agents: products and machines.
